notes: No school-specific supplemental essay found for first-year applicants. The official How to Apply page (https://www.holycross.edu/admissions-aid/how-to-apply) lists 'What's Required?' as the Common Application or Coalition (Scoir) application, transcript, two recommendations, $65 fee and the ED agreement; it lists no writing supplement. Optional items are an interview, test scores, Schoolhouse certifications, and 'Supplementary materials that showcase your special talents or achievement, such as artwork, recorded performances, original writing, research and additional recommendations' (via SlideRoom). The Common App 2026-27 Requirements Grid (updated 09-25-2026) lists Holy Cross deadlines (ED 11/15/2026, EDII 1/15/2027, RD 01/15/2027), Personal essay = Y, and SlideRoom portfolio. The grid's Writing supplement column is blank for Holy Cross, but it is also blank for schools that do have supplements (e.g. Boston College, Cornell), so the grid does not settle it on its own. The Common App explore page shows no writing questions. Cycle confirmed as 2026-27 from those deadline years. UNCERTAIN: older Holy Cross pages (a 2013 admissions blog post, and a cached hcappsdev.holycross.edu interviews page that returned 503) mention an OPTIONAL 'Holy Cross Response' or additional questions on the Applicant Status Portal after submission. In the past it was offered to students who could not interview. A 2023 Top Tier Admissions article also calls this a 'stealth essay'. No official page shows its current wording, so it is not recorded here. Applicants should check their portal after submitting. The QuestBridge page says the Holy Cross QuestBridge Supplement has no additional essays. Third-party Draftl also says no supplement for 2026-27. Do not confuse this school with Holy Cross College (Notre Dame, IN).
